summary.text: Tony Caplan is a Democratic state representative from Merrimack 8 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A business owner and former journalist, he owns Hope Mountain Press.

paragraphs.text: Tony Caplan was born in Venezuela and earned a B.A. in American studies from Yale University in 1982.
His career experience includes owning Hope Mountain Press and working as an editorial writer, a journalist with the Associated Press and United Press International, and a high school Spanish teacher.
He has served as chair of the Henniker Energy Committee and the Henniker Democratic Town Committee.
Caplan's tenure in the New Hampshire House began in 2020, according to Ballotpedia.
He served on the Science, Technology and Energy Committee in 2023-2024 and the Environment and Agriculture Committee in 2021-2022.
